sourceAsset.capturedFrom: FailSafe 6.0.11 release candidate (RC commit 43ab0ecb) in VS Code on Windows, demo workspace 'failsafe-demo-workspace' (fictional Tasklet service, issue TASK-14). Edits were made by a scripted driver, not an AI agent.

derivation: Crop of the 1920x1080 source at left 360, top 256, 1552x776 (2:1). Pixels unaltered; WebP re-encode at quality 90.

files.altText: VS Code editing a due-date validator for issue TASK-14, with a FailSafe notification: the save needed an active intent for a risk level L2 change, the write was not prevented, risk grade L2, and buttons to Create Intent or View Active Intent.
files.caption: FailSafe notices a risky change made without a declared intent, grades it, and tells you; it doesn't silently block your work.
